thread:
Zoe: Quick poll—midnight office watch party this Friday? theme: comfort movies. Throw one title you adore and a one-line reason. I'll tally.
Liam: Inception. Good band-of-bros energy and keeps everyone awake :alarm_clock:
Hannah: The Princess Bride. Quotable, harmless, and it makes people smile.
Omar: Spirited Away. Visual candy and slightly creepy in a cozy way.
Priyanka: Groundhog Day. Time-loop laughs and weirdly hopeful.
Zoe: Nice variety. Rules: keep it under 2.5 hours and no spoilers in the thread.
Liam: Also snacks are welcome. I vote for nachos.
Hannah: Popcorn + tea for me. Non-negotiable.
Omar: If Spirited Away wins, can we dim the lights and light a fake incense? aesthetic points.
Priyanka: Vote reaction: :one: for Inception, :two: Princess Bride, :three: Spirited Away, :four: Groundhog Day.
(mutters of reactions)
Zoe: Results so far: 1) :two: 2) :three: 3) :four: 4) :one: (small sample)
Liam: Also tiny idea: quick 5-minute intro where each person says why they chose it. Micro-ceremony vibes.
Hannah: Love. I'll make a tiny printable handout with quotes. @WatchBot can you create the event and poll?
WatchBot: Created event "Office Comfort Watch Party" on Friday 23:00 in the kitchen. Poll created: https://redwood.example/event/office-watch-party :robot_face:
Omar: Can we livestream for remote folks? Also add a second viewing later for other time zones.
Zoe: Yes. We'll stream and record. Also adding a late-afternoon replay for APAC.
Priyanka: Tiny merch idea: limited-run "I survived the watch party" sticker for attendees. Low effort, high brag.
Liam: I will design a sticker if we hit 20 RSVPs.
Hannah: If Princess Bride wins, I demand costumes. Not negotiable.
Omar: If Spirited Away wins, I'll bring Japanese candies and pretend I'm the bathhouse manager.
Priyanka: Groundhog Day wins my heart but costumes are optional.
WatchBot: Poll closed. Winner: The Princess Bride (54% of 32 votes). Event updated with viewing order and streaming link.
Zoe: Princess Bride it is. Costume suggestions: simple things (bandana, fake sword, flower crown). No elaborate armor unless willingly purchased.
Liam: Nacho bar arranged. I will coordinate with facilities for extra plates.
Hannah: Printing handouts now. Who wants quote suggestions? drop them here and I'll pick six.
Omar: "Inconceivable!" for sure.
Priyanka: "As you wish." also tears.
Zoe: Love this energy. See you Friday, midnight snackers. :movie_camera: :popcorn:
